gap.why: 2000-0025-0003 turning the 120 deg slot cam; the hood is pinned to the command (rigid)

motor.why: 5203-2402-0003: 1620 rpm free / 0.25 A, 0.5296 N.m / 9.2 A at 12 V (vendor), on the arm, GT2 50T:20T up to the wheel (constants at the wheel)

v10.why: 9b lift: free pivot under gravity on a catch (the 9b rest); the catch retracts on fire and re-engages above it

variant.label: Turret 9b (full CAD)
variant.describe: Layout 9b, every part of the code-CAD (sim/mechanism/turret/cad.py). Hood and extension held rigidly at the servo command; the lift wheel is a free pivot under gravity that rests on a catch 3 mm above a seated NECTAR, drops onto the ball when the catch retracts and is caught again as it falls back. The robot (cell, U, lift) is at a random angle under the turret each shot.
